evidence.description: REQ-307's canonical 9-step call order (contracts/sprint-2.md CRIT-201) has no step for shelter-cost-ledger.js::appendShelterCostEntry; defaultDeploy hardcodes shelterCostUsd:null and deployStep.value (leaseId+shelterCostUsd) is discarded immediately after the deploy step succeeds -- see FIND-002.

PROP-303c (Tier 1/2, required:true, sprint-1-marked-proved) does not appear in any of the 3 enumerated buckets (30 targeted for closure / 3 Tier-3 / 5 additionally re-deferred) that this contract claims exhaustively reconciles sprint-1's 38 deferred obligations -- confirmed absent by grep of contracts/sprint-2.md.

PROP-303c's sprint-1 'proved' status comes exclusively from spawn-gap-coverage.test.mjs's direct library-level round-trip test (appendShelterCostEntry called directly on a fixture file) -- it never exercised spawn-orchestrator.mjs's real call graph, confirmed by independent re-read of that test.

Independently re-executed fresh: 175/175 tests pass, 0 failures -- matches manifest's stated 175/175 claim exactly. All other spec-level checks (REQ-201-206/301-306 pre-existing hardened text, REQ-307's own step 1-9/CRIT-201-208 text) read consistent with the delivered code for every requirement OTHER than the shelter-cost-ledger gap above.

nextChildId is monotonic max+1 -- every spawn attempt (including a retry after a prior failure) always mints a brand-new child_id and, at step 2, a brand-new EVM wallet; a prior failed attempt's already-seeded child wallet/address is never revisited -- see FIND-001 for the resulting stranded-gas-seed consequence.

Confirmed the cooldown/failure-cap mechanism genuinely bounds (but does not eliminate) FIND-001's exposure: at most 3 failed attempts (each capable of stranding one gas-seed transfer) are permitted within a 14-day window before decideColonySpawn returns eligible:false, reason:'rate_limited'.

Independently re-read both files: every PROP-307c/seedChild/persistChildWallet test verifies a SINGLE attempt's ledger-row shape in isolation; none asserts anything about cross-attempt fund disposition after a post-seed failure, confirming this edge case is genuinely untested, not merely untested-but-covered-elsewhere.

Direct read confirms the real 9-step canonical order (as REQ-307 currently states it, independent of the FIND-002 gap in that stated order itself) is implemented faithfully: runStep's shared try/catch/requireOk shape, appendMinimalFailure for steps 1-6, appendSpecFailure (buildChildSpec-based) for steps 7-9, and the withGigLock wrapper around the entire runAttempt closure all match the spec's own text exactly.

Independently re-verified defaultDeploy's REQ-304 funding-gate sequencing (evaluateAkashFundingGate called before any deploy-akash.sh invocation, exactly one bridge attempt on an insufficient first pass, deploy-akash.sh never invoked when the gate stays not-ready) and assertRealEvmAddress's independent keccak re-derivation (viem privateKeyToAccount) reject a sha256-fallback-shaped address -- all PASS, matching source.

Confirmed the single-citizen-colony case (citizens.seed.json is now Franklin-only, automaton excluded per commit 2f1462b) introduces no dangling assumption anywhere in spawn-orchestrator.mjs, treasury-gate.mjs, colony-balances.mjs, or wake-gate.mjs: grep for citizens.length/citizens[<index>]/hardcoded 'automaton' string comparisons in these 4 files returns zero matches (the '.automaton' hits are all the unrelated ~/.automaton state-directory convention shared by every citizen, not a special-cased identity check), and treasury-gate.test.mjs's own 'REQ-101 edge case: exactly one self-funded citizen (N=1) needs no special case' test independently passes.

CRIT-201: confirmed exactly one executeSpawnAttempt export exists, spawn-orchestrator.mjs never references run.sh, and run.sh's current production body (lines 1-50) execs scripts/wake-gate.mjs (no OLD lib/spawn-decision.js/DigitalOcean/AgentMail path anywhere in its reachable code -- confirmed by direct read, corroborating the PROP-307e structural test).

CRIT-201 (run.sh->wake-gate.mjs->spawn-orchestrator.mjs chain): direct read confirms a real, non-dry-run, eligible:true invocation genuinely calls decideColonySpawnPure then executeSpawnAttemptReal with real inputs (resolveDrivingCitizen's own resolveEvmPrivateKey/resolveSolanaSecret resolution, real fetchEvmBalanceUsd/fetchSolanaBalanceUsd) unless a test explicitly overrides via `deps` -- confirmed genuine, not a stub, matching the manifest's own item (1) instruction.

CRIT-202: independent grep confirms zero eligibility/threshold comparisons and zero LLM/prompt references anywhere in spawn-orchestrator.mjs -- executeSpawnAttempt is pure sequencing/error-propagation, matching PROP-307b's own structural test.

CRIT-204: confirmed the "colony-spawn" lock (withGigLock) wraps the ENTIRE runAttempt closure (steps 1-9), released only after the lock's own try/finally completes; PROP-307d's staggered-race integration test independently re-run and PASSES.
Independently executed fresh (not accepted from any prior evidence log): tests 175, pass 175, fail 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0, todo 0 -- exact match to the manifest's stated claim.

CRIT-208: confirmed state.json shows a genuine 1b->1c->2a transition for sprint 2 ("Sprint 2 Phase 1c PASSED at iteration 3 (fresh adversary, zero findings)") recorded BEFORE the 2a->2b (TDD RED confirmed) transition -- Phase 1c gate for this sprint's own REQ-307/PROP-307a-d genuinely preceded Phase 2.

CRIT-205/206: sampled a representative cross-section of the 30 targeted PROP IDs (PROP-202d's deployTarget-fed Solana keygen call site, PROP-307c's per-step failure branches, PROP-105i's citizen-registry append, PROP-307e's run.sh wiring) against current source -- all genuinely exist and are reachable, corroborated by passing tests for each. No artifact anywhere claims PROP-302b/PROP-303b/PROP-401a (the 3 Tier-3 real-money obligations) proved via a fixture/simulated/borrowed artifact -- confirmed absent from state.json and all verification/ output.
